title: HELIX Bridge: Banner → StudentProgram
saas_vs_onprem: Banner SaaS (Ellucian Cloud) uses the same underlying Oracle schema. Access methods differ: on-prem uses direct Oracle SQL; SaaS uses Ellucian Data Connect (EDC), Ethos Integration API, or Banner Integration API (BIA). Table/column names are identical across both deployment models.

source_tables.description: Student general. Student type, level, college, major, advisor, residency, class. Effective-term dated (one row per term with changes).
Student curriculum major. Links student to specific major(s) within their curriculum. Supports primary, secondary, minor.
Student level GPA. GPA calculations by level (UG, GR) with term and cumulative breakdowns. Includes hours attempted, earned, quality points.
Student enrollment term. Term-level enrollment data: enrolled hours, academic standing, enrollment status (full/part-time).
Student type validation. First-time freshman, transfer, readmit, continuing, etc.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Deterministic UUID from institution_id + PIDM + SGBSTDN_LEVL_CODE + SORCMJR_MAJR_CODE.
Map Banner student status: 'AS'→'active', 'IS'→'withdrawn', 'GR'→'completed', 'EX'→'dismissed'. Institution-defined in STVSTST.
Resolve admit term to HELIX AcademicPeriod.helix_id.
Use overall cumulative GPA for the matching level. SHRLGPA has rows for institutional, transfer, and overall GPA.
Cumulative earned hours from overall GPA record.
The term whose catalog requirements govern the student's degree.
